summary: Fetch release-delivery snapshots from the verified local source and clean abandoned Git transfer packs under the delivery lock.

schema.detail: No persistent delivery-state or database schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes; trusted commit ancestry and monotonic build protections remain enforced.

compatibility.detail: Delivery transfers a local snapshot only after a bounded ls-remote request proves publication at the approved origin. Branch snapshots must equal the published tip; pinned commits may be locally provable ancestors of published tips. Unavailable proof skips all delivery, including cached installation. Snapshot outcomes include SHA, ref and commit time.

downtime.detail: No live scheduler activation or app installation is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: Deployment owners must adopt the reviewed worker source and ensure the configured local source repository's origin remote-tracking ref is refreshed. Delivery no longer refreshes that ref over the network.

recovery.detail: Transfers use isolated object directories and publish complete objects by hard link. Failure kills and reaps the transfer group before deleting only its owned directory. Shared temporary packs require age over one hour and lsof proof of no live users; missing lsof, warnings or errors retain them. SIGTERM is blocked until the cancellation handler owns the spawned process group. Local transfer failures retain existing trusted-observation retry behavior only after publication proof succeeds.
